excluded_from_vocabulary._comment: Office-like names that appear in the corpus but are EXTERNAL agencies, not campus offices a student can be referred to. Same false-positive class the Data Sourcing Appendix flagged for 'Patent Office' in the IP chapter.

open_questions: SCHOLARSHIP: assigned to Student Affairs and Services Department as an explicit PLACEHOLDER at the user's direction (2026-08-08), pending confirmation. No separate scholarship office appears anywhere in the corpus text. See rule for HDBK / PART 3 / CHAPTER IV.
ADMISSIONS: no 'Office of Admissions' appears in the corpus. Student admission is currently routed to the Office of the University Registrar. Needs confirmation.

ALUMNI / INTERNSHIP: the Internship Manual's own front matter reads 'PLACEMENT, ALUMNI, AND LINKAGES'. Only 'Linkages Department' was found in prose. The unit may actually be named 'Placement, Alumni and Linkages Department'. Needs confirmation.
STUDENT DISCIPLINE OFFICE: appears 7x in prose and is treated as a distinct unit from SASD. Confirm whether it is a separate office or a function inside SASD.

Confirm that 'Student Affairs and Services Department', 'University Health Department', and 'Management Information Systems Department' are the CURRENT unit names and have not been renamed since the 2022/2023 editions.
